about: Curated reading order for the published hardening runs. Numbers are computed from each run's report, never typed here. Every published hardening run must appear once, as a milestone, a head-to-head run or a supporting run with a reason. Nothing is deleted: history stays append-only.
before: Before these milestones, a 42-case development set was used while the agent was being built (30 of 42 on 20 Sept). The agent had been tuned against it, so a fresh held-out set was written and frozen before the agent ever saw it. The chart starts there.

milestones.title: Held-out baseline
changed: 30 new cases, frozen before the first run
Known gaps deliberately left unfixed so the score is honest
milestones.why: An honest starting point on requests the agent had never been tuned on.

milestones.title: Places, money, payment, dates
changed: Real airport list for country menus and misspellings
Budgets in USD only
A saved card never authorises payment
No invented dates
Policy answers grounded in the published snapshot
milestones.why: The baseline failed on the basics: unknown cities, currency loops, and payment wording. Two frozen expectations were wrong and were corrected, with the reasoning kept beside the cases.

milestones.title: Ask, don’t guess
changed: Ambiguous requests get a question, not a search on a guess
Place names kept exactly as typed
No invented dates or cabin labels
milestones.why: The remaining exact failures were the model guessing: “Sidney”, “make it the 3rd”, “back to business”.

milestones.title: A steadier judge
changed: Judge effort raised from low to medium
Test-contract corrections and an article fix
milestones.why: At low effort the judge passed and failed identical replies on consecutive runs. Every exact check passes from here.

milestones.title: Checkout link, six reply fixes
changed: Every results reply links to the same search on commonswyft.com
Six reply fixes, each with a new held-out case
Stricter judge: Opus 5.5
milestones.why: Six new cases pin the checkout link and the reply fixes. The stricter judge flags wording the old judge let through, so some judge flags are new without any change to those replies.

milestones.title: Take me anywhere added
changed: Deals from the product’s public deals feed
11 new Discover cases (G1–G11)
milestones.why: All 11 new cases failed exact checks on the first run. The model sent empty values (a blank region, a zero budget) and the app treated them as real filters. That was fixed next.

milestones.title: Empty values, memory
changed: Empty or zero values are ignored, in both tools
Last-used origin remembered and disclosed
Saying your home airport saves it
The deals feed decides what is current
milestones.why: Fixes the Discover failures and adds the memory rules agreed on 23 Sept. G5, C1 and A8 still failed and were fixed next.
